entries.title: Psalms 64:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David prays for deliverance, complaining of his enemies. 7 He promises himself to see such an evident destruction of his enemies, as the righteous shall rejoice at it.

A.M. 2943. B.C. 1061. Hear. 27:7; 55:1,2; 130:1,2; 141:1; 143:1-3; La 3:55,56 preserve. 17:8,9; 31:13-15; 34:4; 56:2-4; Ac 18:9,10; 27:24

entries.title: Psalms 64:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: encourage. Ex 15:9; Nu 22:6; Pr 1:11-14; Isa 41:6; Re 11:10 matter. or, speech. commune. 1Sa 23:19-23; Mt 23:15; 26:3,4 of laying snares. Heb. to hide snares. 124:7; 140:5 Who. 10:11; 59:7; 94:7; Eze 8:12

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: search. 35:11; 1Sa 22:9; 24:9; 25:10; Da 6:4,5; Mt 26:59; Joh 18:29,30; 19:7 they accomplish, etc. or, we are consumed by that which theyhave thoroughly searched. a diligent search. Heb. a search searched. both. 5:9; Pr 20:5; Isa 29:15; Jer 17:9,10; 1Co 4:5

entries.title: Psalms 64:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: God. 7:12,13; 18:14; De 32:23,42; Job 6:4; La 3:12,13 suddenly. 4; 73:19; Pr 6:15; 29:1; Isa 30:13; Mt 24:40,50,51; 1Th 5:2,3 shall they be wounded. Heb. their wound shall be. 1Ki 22:34; 1Ch 10:3-7
